whatIs: Websitevice is a gallery of real websites organized by type of business. A sidebar lists about 43 categories, such as Agency, SaaS, Restaurant, Dentist, or Real Estate, and each one has its own page of examples with a link to the site and a short description of its design.
It's a good fit when you're hired to build a site for a specific industry and want to see what others in the same sector do before proposing a structure.
uses: Seeing what restaurant or cafe websites look like before laying out a client's site in that industry.
Reviewing sites in the SaaS category to decide which sections go in its landing page and pricing page.
Showing a client examples from their own industry to agree on a visual style.
caveats: You can only browse by category: there's no search or filters by style, color, or technology.
Each example comes with a short description and a link, not an analysis of the design or of how it's built.
The homepage includes a sponsors section that's easy to mistake for the examples at first glance.
pricingNote: You can browse the whole thing without an account or payment.
idealFor: Anyone building sites for clients in specific industries who needs references by sector.
